extraction.tier_rationale: An age-dependent multiplier on the Janmahasatian (2005) FFM that extends validity into childhood; monotone in weight (no inversion). The size descriptor the Eleveld (2017/2018) general-purpose models are built on. Awaits human confirmation of the sex-specific age factors.
extraction.source_locator: Al-Sallami HS et al., Clin Pharmacokinet 2015; the FFM used by Eleveld 2017/2018
